name: agentgateway
short_desc: MCP gateway that aggregates many MCP servers behind one endpoint
author: agentgateway
description: agentgateway is an agentic proxy that fronts any number of MCP servers and exposes them to clients as a single streamable-HTTP endpoint at /mcp, with a management UI at /ui. Two MCP servers ship with it as loopback-only sidecars that can be switched on or off individually — Grafana (dashboards, datasources, Prometheus/Loki queries, alerting) and Tailscale (devices, routes, ACLs) — alongside the public Cloudflare documentation server. The install form carries only secrets and sidecar settings; targets themselves are defined in config.yaml, which is seeded on first start and editable from the UI.

form_fields.label: Enable Grafana MCP sidecar
form_fields.hint: Runs the Grafana MCP server and adds a grafana target on first start. Turn off to idle the sidecar; remove the target from config.yaml as well.

form_fields.label: Grafana URL
form_fields.hint: Base URL of your Grafana, e.g. https://grafana.example.com/. Another Runtipi app is reached by container name, not by its public hostname.

form_fields.label: Grafana service account token
form_fields.hint: Grafana → Administration → Service accounts. Viewer role is enough for read-only tools.

form_fields.label: Grafana MCP bearer token
form_fields.hint: Generated automatically. Authenticates the gateway to the Grafana sidecar over loopback.

form_fields.label: Enable Tailscale MCP sidecar
form_fields.hint: Runs the Tailscale MCP server and adds a tailscale target on first start. Turn off to idle the sidecar; remove the target from config.yaml as well.

form_fields.label: Tailscale API key
form_fields.hint: tskey-api-... from the Tailscale admin console. Without it the Tailscale sidecar exits on start and its tools are skipped.

form_fields.label: Tailscale tailnet
form_fields.hint: Tailnet name, e.g. example.com or example.ts.net.

form_fields.label: Tailscale tool risk level
form_fields.hint: Highest risk level the Tailscale tools may reach. Leave at read unless you want the agent changing your tailnet.

form_fields.label: Tailscale MCP bearer token
form_fields.hint: Generated automatically. The Tailscale MCP server rejects tokens shorter than 32 characters.

form_fields.label: Grist API key
form_fields.hint: Only a secret — the Grist endpoint itself goes in config.yaml, which has a commented example. Grist → Profile Settings → API key.

form_fields.label: Extra host mapping
form_fields.hint: One <hostname>:<ip> entry added to the gateway's /etc/hosts. Use <domain>:host-gateway to reach another app on this host by its public domain — needed for servers that route on Host, like Grist. Left empty it falls back to a no-op mapping.
